resolved_findings.issue: A failed atomic template selection left missing state and stale card actions; Fill could not recover.
resolved_findings.resolution: The pending card clears stale values, disables Reset and Copy, and Fill retries the selected template. Prior task values remain cached.

resolved_findings.issue: Composite reset retained filled cards when its initial optional template presentation had failed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reset restores the canonical bare template when annotated template presentation is unavailable.

resolved_findings.resolution: The bare view shows a concise explanation and named input chips; filling shows the native mathematical condition.

resolved_findings.resolution: Random selection now displays the bare template; filling is a separate action.
